title: Abanoonya Amazima Abawombeefu
intro: Mu nsi erimu obuyinza obw’edda n’obulogo, okulwanagana okunene kubaawo. Oludda olumu lukozesa obuyinza bw’obubonero obw’obwakatonda, ate olulala lugezaako okukwatagana n’ebitasoboka. Ebinaavaamu bijja kukyusa emirembe gyonna ekkubo ly’ebyafaayo. Osobola okubikkula abo abaalaba amazima ag’enkomerero ne beetoowaza mu maaso gaago?
clues: Twalaba obubonero obwali busukka ku bukodyo bw’obulogo
Ffenna twagwa mu kuvunnama, nga tetusobola kwegaana mazima
Twakitegeera nti obubonero buno bwava eri Katonda Omu ow’Amazima
Ffe twali kitundu ekyasooka okukkiriza okukkiriza mu ngeri ey’ekitalo bwetyo
Twasuubizibwa olusuku lwaffe ng’empeera yaffe olw’enzikiriza yaffe
Emiguwa n’emiggo gyaffe byafuuka emisota mu maaso gaffe, naye ne tusalawo okugondera

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
